title: Grow a slice or size it first
note: Appending to an empty slice reallocates the backing array as it grows. Sizing it with make allocates once.

title: Return a value or a pointer
note: Returning the struct copies it to the caller, so it can stay on the stack. Returning its address makes it outlive the call, so it moves to the heap.

title: Value or pointer receiver
note: A value receiver works on a copy, so the count never changes. A pointer receiver changes the original.

title: Unbuffered or buffered channel
note: Without a buffer, every send waits for the receiver. With room for three, the sender finishes without waiting.
